title: Fix reservation accounting without touching the model
goal: Fix shop.inventory.Inventory so reservations are accounted correctly, and add commit. shop/models.py must not change.
acceptance_criteria: available(sku) is on_hand - reserved (0 for an unknown sku)
reserve(sku, qty) raises ValueError for qty <= 0 and models.OutOfStock when qty exceeds available(sku) (including unknown skus), leaving all state unchanged; otherwise returns a new reservation id
release(reservation_id) frees the reserved quantity exactly once; releasing an unknown or already used id raises KeyError
commit(reservation_id) turns a reservation into a sale (on_hand and reserved both drop by its quantity), returns the quantity and raises KeyError for an unknown or already used id
shop/models.py is not modified and existing method signatures stay
